posting.raw_text:
Figma — Forward Deployed Engineer
URL: [URL removed]

ABOUT THE ROLE
Forward Deployed Engineers sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and strategic customers. Work hands-on with customers adopting emerging Figma developer workflows, starting with Make Local, to understand technical environments, unblock implementation, and translate real-world deployment patterns into product and engineering insights.

Partner closely with Customer Experience, Solutions Consulting, Sales, Product, and Engineering to help customers get to value faster while shaping how Figma builds and scales a new Forward Deployed Engineering motion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Partner directly with strategic customers to understand technical goals, workflows, codebase environments, and implementation constraints
- Lead technical discovery and readiness assessments for customer deployments, including repo/environment setup, permissions, configuration needs, and potential adoption blockers
- Provide hands-on implementation support for Make Local and related developer-facing workflows, including setup guidance, debugging, escalation triage, and recommendations on technical implementation patterns
- Work closely with Customer Enablement Managers, Solutions Consultants, Sales, and account teams
- Capture and synthesize product gaps, bugs, workflow patterns, technical blockers, and customer feedback for Product and Engineering teams
- Create reusable deployment assets: technical troubleshooting guides, readiness checklists, account intake templates, implementation playbooks, customer-facing enablement materials
- Help define how Figma should measure success for forward deployed engineering engagements
- Contribute to the operating model for Figma's Forward Deployed Engineering function

QUALIFICATIONS

Required
- Experience in a customer-facing technical role: Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, Sales Engineer, Developer Advocate, or similar
- Strong understanding of modern software development practices: source control, local development environments, deployment workflows, debugging, build tooling
- Proven ability to partner with enterprise customers to solve complex technical challenges
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments

Preferred
- Strong familiarity with developer, design, collaboration, or AI products
- Proven success partnering with enterprise customers on implementation, onboarding, migrations, technical enablement, product adoption
- Solid understanding of frontend development, design systems, component libraries, CI/CD pipelines, monorepos, Dev Infrastructure
- Demonstrated ability to build, scale, or launch customer-facing technical functions
- Ability to translate customer insights into product strategy, documentation, roadmap recommendations

SALARY
152,800 – 296,000 USD + equity

LOCATION
San Francisco, CA / New York, NY / Remote US

materials.cover_letter:
Your Forward Deployed Engineer role is about partnering with enterprise customers on real technical problems. The seven years before that, I built the documentation systems that taught me what good content engineering looks like.

At Redwood I built FlareGuard, an AI content validation workflow with automated checks and regression detection. Escalations dropped 70 to 80 percent. I redesigned a 200-article help portal with role-aware navigation and built a PDF pipeline that fixed a complaint customers had for years. At Bird I migrated 500+ Zendesk articles and shipped an in-app help system. At Attentive I owned documentation for an SMS platform and worked directly with Support and Engineering to debug and triage issues.

Your posting asks for someone who can lead technical discovery, handle setup and debugging, and synthesize feedback for Product and Engineering. I have done exactly that, across codebases, deployment workflows, and enterprise adoption blockers. Figma's focus on developer workflows and close customer loops is why I am applying. I would welcome the conversation.

short_answers.Why this company?: Figma’s commitment to enabling developers with tools like Make Local aligns perfectly with my experience bridging technical teams and customer needs. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, I’d thrive in the ambiguous challenges of enterprise deployments, drawing on my proven ability to diagnose adoption blockers and deliver hands-on support that scales. I’m excited to apply my cross-functional collaboration skills to capture product feedback and drive solutions that directly impact Figma’s strategic customers.

I excel at translating customer pain points into actionable solutions, whether debugging a pipeline or partnering with enterprise clients to meet complex technical challenges.
